title: Cook Book
tagline: Easy-to-follow recipes for actions onchain. Helping beginners and experts alike!
description:
Cookbook lets new users and experts alike learn and share in web3. There are a ton of multi-step actions that are spread across web3. Knowing what to do in what order can be difficult!

Recipes are the most simple, shareable way to learn and knowledge-share across all topics, tech, and experience levels in web3. With inspiration from quests, bounty boards, and community-created tutorials you have to try this today!
how_its_made:
CookBook is built with Next.js and TypeScript. We made use of Figma to create the initial designs and together with plenty of coffee built out the web app. It is deployed on Vercel so it's available globally at record speed.

We've built out "recipes" for nearly every web3 protocol we could find time for! We know recipes will help people get their first SAFE's,
